svg.text: ECOSTEP QCU: PIEZOELECTRIC ENERGY HARVESTING PLATFORM
RECYCLED PLASTIC ECO-BRICK TREAD & 4-TILE GRID HARVESTER (JR EAST TOKYO STATION MODEL)

g.text: 1. TOP IMPACT TREAD (Melted HDPE / PET Recycled Plastic Eco-Brick 20mm)
2. POINT-FORCE ACTUATION STUDS (Converts Foot Step Pressure into Dynamic Disc Deflection)
SPRING TRAVEL: 2.0 mm (Damps impact & prevents ceramic fracture)
3. TRANSDUCER LAYER: 16x PZT-5H Ceramic Discs on Peripheral Edge Support
4. RIGID SUB-CHASSIS & WIRING CAVITY (15mm Depth for Electronics)
SECTION 3: ELECTRICAL HARVESTER & AR101 INTERFACE ARCHITECTURE
• Harvested Energy per Step: E = 0.5 · C · V² (With C = 16 x 25nF = 400nF, V = 35V Peak ⇒ E ≈ 0.245 mJ raw per impact)
• Dynamic Mechanical Strain: V_open = (g33 · F · t) / A (Piezoelectric Voltage Constant g33 ≈ 26.1 x 10⁻³ Vm/N)
• Tokyo Station Density: 400,000 commuters/day x 0.1W-sec ≈ 40 kJ/day per turnstile array (~11.1 Wh daily)
• Direct BSIT AR101 Application: Powers autonomous zero-grid ticket sensors, turnstile displays & passenger bus counters.
